def saisie():
    b=False
    while(b==False):
        s=input('introduire votre numero')
        b=verif(s)
    return s
def verif(s):
    b=len(s)==8
    i=-1
    while(b and i < len(s)-1):
        i=i+1
        b='0'<=s[i]<='9'
    return b

def miroir(s):
    ch=''
    for i in range(len(s)):
        ch=ch+'-'
    return ch
